goalSummary: Bare CLI invocations of claude, copilot, or opencode outside the coding project fail to reach provider APIs entirely.

facts.why: The confined proxy port for all provider egress must be documented
The specific embeddings passthrough endpoint added for in-process callers must be documented
The shim endpoint for codegraph telemetry stamping must be identified
The raw credential env var patterns removed from container bootstrap must be documented
Fix: fail-closed isolation must be scoped only to bin/coding invocations with these flags, not machine-wide
The cross-session task-state file used to resume the multi-tier effort must be identified
